question: Ashish Sankrityayan is an exponent of _________ music.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhrupad**__.​

__
 
• Ashish Sankrityayan is an exponent of **Dhrupad** music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashish Sankrityayan **is a **dhrupad** exponent and since **2011** has worked as the guru and director of the Dhrupad Kendra, Bhopal – an institution of the Madhya Pradesh Government established in 1981 to give training in the traditional guru-shishya system of apprenticeship to aspiring dhrupad singers.
 
• As an exponent of the Dagar Tradition of Dhrupad, Ashish S has trained for twenty years under three maestros of the Dagar family and is well known for his frequent concert appearances and teaching. 
 
• Ashish S started his musical training at an early age, first learning the sitar and subsequently vocal music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhrupada** is possibly the oldest surviving musical form of North India. T
 
• The word **Dhrupada** is a combination of the two words ***Dhruva* & *Pada***. 
 
• **Dhruva** which means structured fixed or rigid, that does not alter its course, and **pada**, means word or syllable, a metrical foot, denoting the composition. 
 
• The word **Dhrupada** therefore means a composition in which the padas or words are set in a definite structure or pattern.
